response.sql:
WITH gender_order_counts AS (
    SELECT c.gender, COUNT(*) AS order_count
    FROM Orders o
    JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    WHERE CAST(o.date_order_placed AS TEXT) BETWEEN '2013-10-25 17:40:25' AND '2017-05-24 19:26:44'
    GROUP BY c.gender
),
average_count AS (
    SELECT AVG(order_count) AS avg_order_count
    FROM gender_order_counts
)
SELECT g.gender,
       g.order_count,
       g.order_count - a.avg_order_count AS above_average
FROM gender_order_counts g
CROSS JOIN average_count a
WHERE g.order_count > a.avg_order_count;

assumptions.assumption: The average is computed across genders that occur among qualifying orders; genders with no qualifying orders are not included.
